old_description: Electronic Services Inc. is a family owned and operated business serving first responders, Government agencies, School systems, businesses & general public in West Virginia since 1971, Incorporated October of 1988, and in the spring of 1997 built our first full services sales service and installation facility located in Winfield, WV still in this same location and now in 2021 finished our new 5000sq foot state of the art vehicle upfitters installation facility which will help us expand and serve more of our local heroes.
about:
Electronic Service Inc. (ESI) is a family-owned communications and installation firm based in Winfield, West Virginia. The company traces its roots to 1971, was incorporated in October 1988, and erected its first full-service sales and installation facility in Winfield in 1997. In 2021 it completed a 5,000-square-foot, state-of-the-art vehicle upfitting shop at the same location to expand capacity for public-safety upfits.

ESI sells and installs two-way radio systems (as a Kenwood dealer since the late 1980s, now offering NXDN and DMR digital platforms), emergency lighting, vehicle and dispatch consoles, law-enforcement radar, paging, vehicle safety products, and car audio. Its service portfolio covers radio repair and maintenance, radio rentals, mobile installations, complete vehicle buildouts, system design, programming, deployment, training, and ongoing support, including field and mountaintop service calls across West Virginia. The shop also designs and installs video surveillance, burglar alarm, and mobile and home audio/video systems.

The customer base spans first responders, government agencies, school systems, commercial businesses, and the general public throughout West Virginia. Concrete examples include county 911 communication consoles, campus two-way radio networks, and public-safety vehicle upfits for law enforcement and fire departments.

The company emphasizes a “100% correct 100% of the time” standard, backed by a combined 70 years of staff experience, a no-shortcuts installation philosophy, and the latest tools and equipment. The 2021 facility investment reflects a stated goal to serve more local heroes with expanded upfitting capability.
